findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext in the Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source code, or Lambda console/API. This is a classic CWE-798 hard-coded credentials issue.

The Lambda function does not configure a KMS CMK (kms_key_arn) for environment variable encryption, relying on default encryption, and combined with plaintext secrets stored in variables this leaves sensitive data poorly protected at rest.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a Node.js runtime version that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
